title: Analysis and interpretation of tables, bar graphs, pictograms, line graphs and pie charts
summary: Read scales and keys, compare categories, and connect chart values to totals and proportions.
objectives: Read values from common tables and graphs.
Use pictogram keys and graph scales correctly.
Convert between pie-chart angles, frequencies and percentages.

blocks.text: Read the title, labels, scale and key before calculating. Bar heights show category values, pictogram symbols use a stated key, line graphs emphasise ordered change, and a pie-chart angle is the same fraction of 360° as its frequency is of the total.

sections.title: Worked example

prompt.text: A 90° pie-chart sector represents 15 students. Find the total number of students.

sections.verification_note: Check the title, scale, key, labels and total before accepting the interpretation.

prompt.text: One pictogram symbol represents 5 books. How many books do 4 symbols represent?

feedback.text: Multiply the symbol count by the key: 4 × 5 = 20.

blocks.text: Identify the data structure and purpose, read every scale and key carefully, calculate from the stated values, then check whether the display gives an accurate and complete impression.
